entity.description:
Cameran Palace (Japanese: オルドラン Oldoran) is an anime-exclusive place in Kanto.

The current ruler of this palace is Lady Ilene and her Pokémon, Mime Jr., at her side. It is located in the center of Rota, a kingdom on the Northside of Kanto. In the past, Queen Rin, Sir Aaron, and Lucario used to reside in this palace. Ash and friends traveled there for a Pokémon Battle competition, and whoever wins will be crowned Guardian of the Aura for the year. Cameran Palace was featured in the movie Lucario and the Mystery of Mew.
